task.title: `vulns exposure --branch` defaults to working-tree HEAD instead of the selected branch tip
task.body:
`git pkgs vulns exposure` has the same branch/ref mismatch that #346 reported for `vulns blame` (fixed in #350).

`runVulnsExposure` resolves `--branch` to a database branch, then defaults `--ref` to the working tree `HEAD`:

```go
branch, err := resolveBranch(db, branchName)
...
targetRef := ref
if targetRef == "" {
    targetRef = refHEAD
}
...
vulns, err = getVulnsAtRef(repo, db, branch.ID, targetRef, ecosystem, ecosystemFilter)
```

(`cmd/vulns.go:2036-2046`)

Running `git pkgs vulns exposure --branch feature` while `main` is checked out queries the `feature` branch history at `main`'s tip commit. If that commit is not in `feature`'s `branch_commits` the result is empty; if it is an ancestor the result reflects an older snapshot. The no-flag default hits the same case whenever the checked-out branch differs from the database's default tracked branch.

The fix is the same shape as #350: when `--ref` is not given, use `branch.LastAnalyzedSHA` instead of `refHEAD`. An explicit `--ref` should keep resolving through `getVulnsAtRef` as it does now.

spec: `vulns exposure --branch` defaults to working-tree HEAD instead of the selected branch tip
